review_summary: Completed a repository-grounded review of the exact base-to-head diff. The PR only removes a redundant output-level deduplication guard from `src/_pytest/fixtures.py`; the current fixture manager stores each registration in one mutually exclusive node-based or legacy nodeid-based collection, so `_get_all_fixture_defs()` does not inherently emit the same registration through both paths. Existing tests also cover fixtures with identical names in different locations, which must remain separately displayed. No sufficiently supported technical issue was found.
